input_source.label: Input source
input_source.description: Where the text comes from when you type nothing after the prefix.

preserve_casing.label: Preserve casing
preserve_casing.description: Keep the original casing inside words, so acronyms and product names such as NASA or iPhone survive the conversion.

notify_on_copy.label: Notify on copy
notify_on_copy.description: Show a notification after copying a conversion to the clipboard.
